name: aee-runtime
description: AEE-4 Part B — AEE Lightweight Agent Runtime (Node.js, in-house). Reads a job spec, calls an OpenAI-compatible LLM, executes shell / file_read / file_write tools inside an allowlist + workdir, returns a single JSON result on stdout. This is NOT a wrapper around an external 'Pi Agent' package; see docs/AEE4_FINAL_VALIDATION_REPORT.md §1.
